items.heading: Palusami Tuvaluan
details: Key ingredients: taro leaves, coconut cream, onion
Layer taro leaves with chopped onion.
Pour coconut cream over the leaves generously.
Wrap tightly and bake or steam until tender.
Serve warm alongside baked taro or fish.

items.heading: Coconut Crab Curry
details: Key ingredients: coconut crab, coconut milk, curry spices
Clean and prepare fresh coconut crab.
Saute curry spices until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and the crab, simmering gently.
Cook until the crab is tender and serve with rice.

items.heading: Pulaka
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
